headlines.title: Florida and Alabama declare states of emergency as Hurricane Isaias nears Gulf Coast
headlines.description: Hurricane Isaias is now a major Category 3 storm, with the National Hurricane Center warning of life-threatening storm surge and devastating winds. NBC News meteorologist Bill Karins breaks down the latest forecast, while Chris Pollone reports from Alabama on the preparations underway as residents brace for impact.

headlines.title: Trump: Russia will send diesel fuel to the U.S. to bring down prices
headlines.description: President Trump said he spoke to Vladimir Putin and Russia will send hundreds of thousands of barrels of diesel fuel to the U.S. aimed at bringing down prices at the pump. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Food pantries overwhelmed by Trump cuts
headlines.description: Those on the front lines of feeding their neighbors in rural West Virginia say they face unprecedented challenges brought on by Washington.

headlines.title: Early vote analysis: Mail ballot concerns are changing how Democrats vote
headlines.description: Democrats are changing how they vote, requesting fewer mail ballots than in past elections but returning the ones they do request more quickly, according to a new NBC News Decision Desk analysis of the early vote conducted in coordination with the University of Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: James Talarico back on the trail after absence with flu drew scrutiny
headlines.description: After drawing scrutiny for his absence from the campaign trail, Democratic Texas Senate candidate James Talarico, who had been sick with the flu, returned to the stump.

headlines.title: NFL Hall of Fame coach Mike Ditka dead at 86
headlines.description: Mike Ditka went from being a Super Bowl winning head coach of the Chicago Bears to a cultural icon. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk looks back at his life and legacy.

headlines.title: Backlash to livestream of firing squad execution
headlines.description: There is criticism of the Trump administration’s decision to livestream the firing squad execution of the Fort Hood mass killer. NBC News’ Ryan Chandler reports.

headlines.title: State Department IG probing Kimberly Guilfoyle amid alleged $100,000 demand
headlines.description: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle and the embassy she leads are under investigation by the State Department’s Office of the Inspector General, two people familiar with the decision confirmed to NBC News.

headlines.title: Katie Zacharia will be the next White House press secretary
headlines.description: Conservative commentator Katie Zacharia is expected to be named the next White House press secretary, replacing Karoline Leavitt.

headlines.title: Country star Ella Langley cancels Tulsa, Oklahoma, show due to ‘serious security threat’
headlines.description: Country singer Ella Langley canceled her sold-out show slated for Friday evening in Tulsa, Oklahoma, due to what she described as “a serious security threat.”

headlines.title: New video shows moments before ICE-involved shooting
headlines.description: New video shows the moments before an ICE-involved shooting in New York City. Officials said the suspect was treated at the hospital and is now in federal detention. DHS said the suspect weaponized his vehicle towards officers. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.
